import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int limit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        double epsilon = 1e-15;
        double ratio = (double) x / y;

        int n = x;
        int d = y;
        double min_diff = 1e9;

        for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
            double val = ((double) x * i) / y;
            double floor_val = Math.floor(val);
            double ceil_val = Math.ceil(val);
            double ratio_floor = floor_val / i;
            double ratio_ceil = ceil_val / i;
            double diff_floor = Math.abs(ratio_floor - ratio);
            double diff_ceil = Math.abs(ratio_ceil - ratio);

            if (diff_ceil == diff_floor) {
                if (diff_ceil < min_diff - epsilon) {
                    n = (int) floor_val;
                    d = i;
                    min_diff = diff_ceil;
                }
            } else if (diff_ceil < diff_floor) {
                if (diff_ceil < min_diff - epsilon) {
                    n = (int) ceil_val;
                    d = i;
                    min_diff = diff_ceil;
                }
            } else {
                if (diff_floor < min_diff - epsilon) {
                    n = (int) floor_val;
                    d = i;
                    min_diff = diff_floor;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(n + "/" + d);
    }
}
